result.name: Zeyu Wang
education_school: University of California, Los 加利福尼亚大学，洛杉矶
work_experience:
Machine Learning Engineer, Amazon, Inc
Researcher of Language Understanding Synthesis Lab of UCLA

AI Agent for Intelligent Risk Detection and Prevention
● Developed and deployed an AI-powered agent for real-time risk detection and decision automation, integrating LLMs and anomaly detection for enhanced accuracy.
● Designed and optimized data preprocessing pipelines, feature engineering techniques, and model training workflows, leveraging supervised learning and self-adaptive AI agent strategies.
● Implemented Function Calling to enable AI agents to dynamically interact with external data sources and APIs, improving real-time adaptability in risk assessment.
● Deployed the AI agent using AWS (S3 for storage, Lambda for compute, SageMaker for model deployment), ensuring scalability, efficiency, and robust model lifecycle management.
● Automated agent retraining and self-improvement mechanisms, enabling continuous learning from new patterns and reducing false positives in risk assessments. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate the AI agent into production environments, achieving a 20% improvement in response time and increasing decision accuracy.

Real-Time AI-Driven Dynamic Pricing and Bidding System
● Developed a real-time dynamic pricing engine using reinforcement learning and time-series forecasting (LSTM, Transformer) to optimize price adjustments across millions of products.
● Designed a low-latency bid optimization model for Amazon Advertising, leveraging multi-armed bandits and deep Q-learning to dynamically adjust ad bids, increasing ROI by 12%.
● Built a millisecond-level competitive pricing system, integrating real-time competitor price tracking and demand forecasting to maximize revenue efficiency.
● Optimized pricing decision latency using AWS Lambda, Redis caching, and ONNX-accelerated inference, reducing price update delays by 30% while handling millions of requests per second.
● Developed an anomaly detection system using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Isolation Forests, reducing pricing errors and fraudulent activities by 25%.
● Deployed the system using AWS SageMaker, Kinesis, and EC2, supporting billions of daily updates with 99.999% uptime and automated scalability.
project_experience:
Language Understanding & Synthesis Lab of UCLA
LLM Causal Reasoning: Developed fundamental causal reasoning evaluation benchmark to assess LLMs causal reasoning capability. (published paper for ACL 2024)
● Causal Reasoning Benchmark Development: Designed and curated a comprehensive dataset aimed at evaluating the causal reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs).
● Causal Inference Engine: Developed a Causal Inference Engine to automatically generate causal hypotheses and label pairs based on predefined causal relationships, ensuring high-quality, diverse causal scenarios for testing.
● Experimental Evaluation Framework: Conducted extensive evaluations across multiple types of causal queries to measure LLM performance, identifying key limitations in current models and setting a new standard for causal reasoning assessment in NLP research.

AI Agent Development and Fine-Tuning for Intelligent Automation
● Developed and fine-tuned AI agents for complex decision-making tasks, leveraging large language models (LLMs) and adaptive reasoning techniques to enhance automation capabilities.
● Implemented Function Calling mechanisms, enabling AI agents to dynamically interact with external tools, APIs, and structured data sources, improving task execution efficiency.
● Designed a scalable fine-tuning pipeline, optimizing model performance across diverse domains using supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and prompt engineering.
● Integrated multi-modal AI capabilities, allowing agents to process and generate text, speech, image, and video outputs, ensuring seamless interoperability across different applications.
● Built AI-driven evaluation and execution platforms, providing real-time monitoring, benchmarking, and optimization for agent performance in production environments.
● Deployed AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain and XAgent, implementing modular architectures that allow adaptive behavior, self-learning, and efficient task orchestration.
● Optimized low-latency inference pipelines, reducing computational overhead by 25% while maintaining high accuracy, ensuring real-time responsiveness in mission-critical applications.

Multi-Stage Ensemble Architecture for Enhanced Logical Reasoning in LLMs (Accepted)
● Developed a novel cascade network architecture combining dynamic candidate filtering, adaptive self-attention, and ensemble decision voting to improve LLMs' logical reasoning capabilities.
● Implemented confidence-based candidate selection and multi-head adaptive attention mechanisms to dynamically adjust attention weights, enabling more precise logical inference and connection identification.
● Enhanced model performance through an intermediate logical representation layer and ensemble decision strategy, improving accuracy from 81.48% (base model) to 88.86% (full ensemble) while maintaining efficient inference time.
● Leveraged parallel processing via multiple specialized components: candidate filtering for relevance scoring, adaptive attention for dynamic weighting, and voting mechanisms for robust decision making, resulting in superior performance on complex multi-step reasoning tasks.

project_experience_zh:
加州大学洛杉矶分校语言理解与合成实验室
LLM因果推理：开发了基本的因果推理评估基准，以评估LLM的因果推理能力。
（为ACL 2024发表的论文）
● 因果推理基准开发：设计并策划了一个全面的数据集，旨在评估大型语言模型（LLMs）的因果推理能力。
● 因果推断引擎：开发了一个因果推断引擎，能够根据预定义的因果关系自动生成因果假设和标签对，确保为测试提供高质量、多样化的因果场景。
● 实验评估框架：对多种类型的因果查询进行了广泛评估，以衡量LLM性能，识别当前模型的关键局限性，并为NLP研究中的因果推理评估设定了新的标准。

智能自动化的AI代理开发与微调
● 开发和微调了用于复杂决策任务的人工智能代理，利用大型语言模型（LLMs）和自适应推理技术来增强自动化能力。
● 实现了函数调用机制，使AI代理能够动态地与外部工具、API和结构化数据源进行交互，提高了任务执行效率。
● 设计了一个可扩展的微调管道，通过使用监督微调、强化学习和提示工程，优化了模型在不同领域的性能。
● 集成多模态人工智能能力，使代理能够处理和生成文本、语音、图像和视频输出，确保不同应用之间的无缝互操作性。
● 构建了基于人工智能的评估和执行平台，为生产环境中的代理性能提供实时监控、基准测试和优化。
● 使用LangChain和XAgent等框架部署AI代理，实施模块化架构，允许自适应行为、自我学习和高效的任务协调。
● 优化了低延迟推理管道，减少了25%的计算开销，同时保持高准确性，确保在关键任务应用中的实时响应。

多阶段集成架构用于增强大型语言模型中的逻辑推理（已接受）
● 开发了一种新颖的级联网络架构，结合动态候选过滤、自适应自注意力和集成决策投票，以提高大型语言模型的逻辑推理能力。
● 实施了基于信心的候选人选择和多头自适应注意力机制，以动态调整注意力权重，从而实现更精确的逻辑推理和连接识别。
● 通过中间逻辑表示层和集成决策策略增强模型性能，将准确率从81.48%（基础模型）提高到88.86%（完整集成），同时保持高效的推理时间。
● 通过多个专门组件利用并行处理：候选人过滤以进行相关性评分，自适应注意力以进行动态加权，以及投票机制以实现稳健的决策，导致在复杂的多步骤推理任务中表现优越。
